## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

**Date:** 2026-06-07  
**Link:** [OpenAI — Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind](https://openai.com/index/introducing-new-capabilities-to-gpt-rosalind/)  
**Summary:** OpenAI introduced new GPT-Rosalind capabilities for enterprise-scale life-sciences research, combining GPT-5.5 agentic coding/tool use with stronger performance in medicinal chemistry, genomics, and broader drug-discovery analysis.  
**Why it matters:** This is a domain-specific push into high-value scientific workflows where model reliability, tooling, and enterprise deployment matter more than general chatbot capability.

**Date:** 2026-06-07  
**Link:** [OpenAI — Frontier models and Codex now available on AWS](https://openai.com/index/openai-frontier-models-and-codex-are-now-available-on-aws/)  
**Summary:** OpenAI announced availability of its frontier models and Codex through AWS, positioning GPT-5.5 and related tools for enterprise deployment through Amazon infrastructure.  
**Why it matters:** AWS availability reduces procurement and deployment friction for large enterprises already standardized on AWS, especially regulated customers that need cloud controls and existing vendor relationships.

**Date:** 2026-06-07  
**Link:** [Reuters via Fidelity — OpenAI plans ChatGPT “superapp” overhaul ahead of listing, FT reports](https://www.fidelity.com/news/article/default/202606070019RTRSNEWSCOMBINED_L1N42F00R_1)  
**Summary:** Reuters, citing the Financial Times, reported that OpenAI is planning a ChatGPT redesign centered on Codex, agents, image generation, and partner services ahead of a potential listing. Reuters noted it could not immediately verify the FT report.  
**Why it matters:** If accurate, this signals OpenAI is moving ChatGPT further from a single assistant interface toward a broader work platform. Treat as unconfirmed until OpenAI announces it.
